name: 044.5 — the surface is a real root: focus, keyboard, popups, tooltips
author: brodgar
description: Self-checking suite for task 044.5: a widget standing in the 3D world takes keyboard focus when clicked and gives it up again, opens its dropdown's list INSIDE the panel rather than on the flat UI, answers a tooltip at the point it is drawn at, and repaints when a hover state changes on it — the transparency rule, proved on everything the client resolves against a root.
